name: Tabletop Kit
summary: Dice with advantage, an initiative tracker and short character sheets for tabletop games.
description: Three tools for a tabletop group. /r rolls dice notation like 2d6+3, 4d6kh3 (keep highest), 4d6dl1 (drop lowest) and the d20 shorthand adv and dis, and shows every die including the ones dropped. The Initiative Tracker app (or /tabletop) is a shared scene: type a name and initiative to add a combatant, sort the order, press next to pass the turn and tap a row to jump to it or its x to remove it. /sheet keeps a short character sheet per player - a name, hp and up to eight stats - and shows yours back. Sheets are stored with the kv.store capability, which an admin approves when installing; one sheet per member, kept under their module id, and the tracker and dice keep nothing.

changes: A very large hp change like /sheet hp +2147483647 fills hp to the maximum instead of dropping it to 0.
First release: dice with advantage, an initiative tracker and character sheets.

author: slim-m
